parsed.summary: Tracing every net across the root sheet and the NFC_IC and DISPLAY sub-sheets, the schematic reproduces the spec's intended topology and values: STM32L476RGT6 with NRST pulled to VCC and BOOT0 to GND; NT3H2111 with SDA/SCL/FD each on a 10 kΩ pull-up to VCC and VOUT/VCC on the VCC rail; SSD1306 strapped BS0=GND, BS1=VCC, BS2=GND with D0=SCL, D1+D2=SDA, RES# pulled up, and the charge-pump network (2.2 µF VCC, two 1 µF flying caps, 4.7 µF VCOMH, 390 kΩ IREF) intact; the TSC block has the 1 kΩ series resistor to the electrode and the 22 nF sampling cap to GND; and the Tag-Connect SWD header carries VCC/GND/RESET/SWCLK/SWDIO. The reference designators are permuted relative to the spec (MCU=U3, NFC=U4, OLED=U2, antenna=A2, TSC=A3, connector=J2) and the antenna tuning cap is left as '??' (a documented known limitation), but neither changes electrical behaviour, and no drawing evidence supports a short, bridge, wrong value, wrong component type, or mis-strap. Verdict: no anomaly.
